Hollow hold. Lay on your back with your arms extended above your head. Raise your legs and your arms, try to make your body into a V. You don’t need to raise your arms and legs really far, but focus on the stretch and isolating your abs.

Cherry pickers is when you are on your back and you raise your legs vertically, and you alternately reach with your left hand to your right foot, and then you right and to your left foot.

Butterfly crunches are like regular crunches, but you touch the bottoms of your feet to each other, knees spread, and with your hands behind your head or ears, do the same crunches attempting to touch your elbows to your knees.

Strong abs will help counteract any lower back pain from planking.

As you are walking, do a safety roll to the right and the left every hundred yards or so.
Can you explain what a safety roll is? I have no clue.

To do it slowly, put both hand on the ground, then tuck your chin and do a somersault so that your head goes on the OUTSIDE of one of your shoulders. You should roll over your shoulder and onto your butt. It is called a safety roll, because it is a safe way to fall. You won't crank your neck or do a full-scorpion. The roll will also take some energy out of the fall.

After you get used to it, you should get back up as quickly as possible. Eventually, you should be able to run, roll, and pop back up and keep running. It is a major workout because you have to lift your whole body off the ground while you are already breathing heavy. You can also do them with a stick (or gun) in your hands. Remember, tuck your chin, and make sure your head goes outside your arms/shoulders, and not between them. If your running and you trip and fall, you should not try to stop yourself with your hand like a pushup, you should roll out of it and get back up and keep running.
